conclusion: No unresolved material dossier-quality issue found within this bounded independent review. The raw candidate remains blocked for native App adoption. No policy repair, expert acceptance or promotion follows.
scope: Complete independent replay and exact identity/coverage checks of this single raw run. All twelve new measure-original pages, ten native production modules and all twenty-four raw assumptions were read directly. Selected source interpretations below were independently checked. This is not a second full semantic adjudication of every common-source page, table value or catalog assessment.
excluded_materials: No study-reference cases, GM/expert accepted labels, historical model-self-test expectations or manual-adaptation test labels were used as oracles. Fresh source controls, desired positive evidence, conditional native-interface examples and outside-schema stress retain distinct scopes.

source_reading.shared_reading: Seven previous complete common-source readings are reused only by exact matching hashes. Current complete SRL pages 59–60 were independently reread; ATB page 10 and Annex page 103 exact quotation contexts and selected Annex-F pages were directly rechecked. Earlier directly checked general participation, management, modulation and notice clauses are reused without claiming a new complete reading.
source_reading.reading_hygiene: Adjacent SRL page 61 was incidentally extracted while locating the end of measure 8; no next-measure finding, expectation or analysis uses it.
source_reading.gsp_package_status: GSP-AV and MOG full texts are absent from these eight supplied originals. Incorporation by supplied sources remains relevant; detailed norms from another source packet are not retrospective generation oracles.

replay.comparison: Complete regenerated observations byte-match the final stored observations, without --write or original mutation.
replay.interpretation: A successful reproduction preserves matching and nonmatching expectations. Selected development probes are not a model-accuracy score, expert gold or proof of totality over arbitrary inputs.

native_loading.numeric_representation: Original JSON literals and frozen binary retained without normalization; the policy and static-data packages intentionally differ.

coverage_quality.table_scope: All thirty inventoried pointers in eight files and 2,407 direct entries were independently compared to exact stored values. No overlapping parent/child pointer expansion applies here. The actual sparse matrix stores 134 positive cells; 286 implicit off-diagonal blanks and 21 diagonal coordinates are separate. Complete primary source reconstruction of 1,952 Annex-F rows is not relabelled as a second independent full semantic table review.
coverage_quality.finding_limit: Groups overlap and include improvements, interpretations, source-only duties and interface/output boundaries; their number is not a count of independent model defects.
coverage_quality.input_count_limit: Twenty-three proposals comprise 22 additions and one existing tillage enum change. Leaf counts distinguish 93 new leaves plus one changed leaf, 93 read and one unread. Helper-only and cap-only consumers remain separate from main-decision effects. Exact proposal identity and annotated locations were independently checked without claiming a second full semantic adjudication of every leaf.

code_location_control.count_unit: Annotated range/line occurrences and quoted-line occurrences, including repeated row/read-site evidence; not unique production lines.
code_location_control.anchor_scope: Some collection-symbol anchors identify the first clause of a multi-clause rule. Valid location alone does not identify every branch; selected actual branches were independently read in context.

additional_reading_page_bounds.scope: Explicit page/read arrays, source page numbers, paired extent endpoints and actual page-count declarations; repeated occurrences counted. This is bounds validation, not proof of source reading or interpretation.

quote_location_control.fallback_resolution: Original MB page 9 extract reads Zuckermais/Feldgemüse, whereas one row-evidence quote adds a space after the slash. Direct context inspection confirms typography only; no word or numeric substitution is accepted.
quote_location_control.summary_resolution: Each otherwise unlocated input-finding summary exactly repeats its own bound source_evidence quote, which is found on its declared original page.
quote_location_control.pre_freeze_corrections: Two ATB metadata bindings and an inferred blank-matrix exclusion were corrected before freeze. Blank-cell non-combinability is now identified as matrix interpretation, not a fabricated literal sentence.
quote_location_control.limit: Text location and valid bounds do not prove legal interpretation, source hierarchy or a new complete reading; repeated evidence is not independent corroboration.

matcher_quality.native_shapes: farm_access_failures and parcel exclusions are string collections; main farm/parcel violations are rule-object collections; parcel_results contains explicit string collections and code-to-number maps.
matcher_quality.expectation_shapes: Every evaluated object matcher targets actual rule objects. String collections, tuples, explicit predicate/count projections and numbers retain their native shapes. Empty arrays alone do not establish an element type.
matcher_quality.representation_limit: Absence, null, false, numeric zero and runtime errors remain distinct. The sources do not prescribe OPA defined/undefined representation.

companion_consistency.separate_app_projection: The primary input ledger separately records the actual SQL-blocked adapter projection and native result. This QC did not rerun that integration or add it to the source-probe count.

source_semantic_controls: Core positive aggregate: actual qualified MS+US on 1 ha, AH on 0.5 ha, BAW on 0.4 ha over a GIS path of 0.1 ha, and DS/StripTill on 1 ha yield 556.20 EUR including the 16.20 EUR BIO-US component; the conventional counterpart yields 540 EUR. Physical participation is 2.9 ha with MS+US counted once. Uncoded permanent grassland has no own component.

The BAW 0.4/0.1 case expressly stipulates actual GIS overlap and absence of other BAW area payments including BIO basic payment. It sits exactly on the quarter boundary and does not adjudicate A01 admission-versus-capping scope. KG membership alone is not GIS proof.
The 0.09/0.10 ha boundary isolates the source minimum; the negative case carries no invented full-farm financial sanction.

Every assigned parcel violation can remove code compliance, then physical participation area, then possibly farm access. The new Core finding records this undifferentiated assessment interface. It does not imply that every zero amount is unlawful, every obligation breach retains admission, or one contrary sanction amount follows.

Winterackerbohnen retains its true main sowing date of 15 October 2024 and an independently stipulated legitimate comparable spring US window on 15 April 2025. The ordinary 56-day check falsely diagnoses that local date; no fabricated spring main sowing or mandatory zero award is used.

The 0.06 ha AH+US Frühkartoffeln/Mais example is explicitly conditional on disclosed native A04, not a newly authorised source combination. The unconsumed fallback helper counts 0.12 ha while the main physical sum correctly yields 0.06 ha. This is not a false-positive final-payment finding.

Known simultaneous enrollment in measures 6 and 7 expects the missing explicit exclusivity diagnosis only; no unique complete sanction is invented. DIV, conversion and transfer helpers retain their limited component and authority-process scopes.

Known BAW care controls stipulate a completed calendar year under disclosed A07; an unknown future cut is not assumed to have been missed. BAW and US management summaries require the source-restricted periods, not undated all-time aggregation.

Fresh BAW parcel geography was corrected before freeze to coherent 31001/Bocksdorf/Burgenland/Güssing. Unused location metadata is not used as contradictory positive evidence. StripTill scenarios retain a consistent actual method context.

Current-year contract start/end, supplied-applicant positive gates, actual season-dependent drought-harvest flag, park obligations, active crop-list consumers and deep-loosening cover gate are preserved as actual improvements over earlier runs.

A known current missing payment application differs from a still-active multiannual obligation; a known effective exit or revision termination differs from a merely matching start/end cohort. These source facts do not all reach code-premium eligibility.

Unrepresented control-refusal, own-account, effective public influence and authority facts are source/interface gaps without fabricated native input fields. An affirmative reason flag is not an AMA decision; positive exception scenarios explicitly stipulate actual recognition.

The cap example fixes 500 ha home area, 81 EUR/ha own gross, 0.92 modulation and 1,220 EUR/ha other already-processed authorised payments. The source-stage sum of 1,294.52 is below 1,300 even though the raw-stage sum of 1,301 triggers the native flag; no excess-allocation formula is invented.

The mixed home/alpine case explicitly defines total area 300 as actual 100 ha home plus 200 ha separately treated measure 14 area. The expected home factor 1 is conditional on that meaning; if upstream total already means home area, this oracle does not apply.

The cross-effect case establishes actual nonperformance of US, not unknown sowing evidence. A code label alone suppresses the UBB/BIO helper despite that known fact; the test does not calculate a complete other-measure award.

Native assumption 1 concerning BAW quarter versus partial/fourfold wording, Sudangras version extension, MS/DS+AH survivor selection, actual drought-control discretion and exact MFA string identity retain their declared interpretations.

The unreferenced April 15 metadata is sourced to permanent circumstances expressly outside force majeure, not a universal higher-force deadline. Actual sanction lookup and reduction-order data are not a completed authority net calculation.
